summary: Order management enhancements: allow admins to add tracking numbers to non-pending orders and show a post-checkout notification instructing customers to contact the owner for payment methods.

existing_features.title: Update the Admin Panel UI to let admins add/edit a tracking number per order, only when the order is no longer pending, and persist the change to the backend with success/error feedback.
Show the tracking number on the Order Details page when it exists.
After a user successfully submits an order, display a notification popup with the exact text: "Please contact the owner for payment methods".

new_feature_requests.summary: Admin area to add/edit a tracking number on orders once they are no longer pending
After an order is submitted, display a notification: "please contact the owner for payment methods"
Extend the backend Order model to store an optional tracking number, and expose it via existing order query methods (getOrder, getAllOrders).
Add a backend admin-only method to set/update an order’s tracking number, and enforce that a tracking number can only be set when the order status is not pending (i.e., approved or shipped).

projectName: Add admin tracking number field for orders and show payment instruction notification after order submission
